identity: A canvas task with draggable cards, resizable boxes, or table dividers that must be placed to match a guide or target layout.

scenarios.name: align
scenarios.screen: Four cards sit at different positions on a canvas beside a dashed guide line. Their movable edges or centres are visibly off the guide; no picker or popup is open.
never: A card already dragged outside the canvas
A numeric readout of each card’s alignment error

arrangements.text: Cards run from top to bottom beside a vertical dashed guide.
Cards spread from left to right around a horizontal dashed guide.
A locked card sits among the other cards, which are offset from one of its edges or its centre.

scenarios.name: spacing
scenarios.screen: Four different-sized cards form a row on the canvas, with uneven gaps between their edges. The end cards are fixed and the cards between them can be dragged; no picker or popup is open.
never: A live gap measurement beside each card
A reorder list or sorting control
An open settings panel for spacing

arrangements.text: The cards form a horizontal row, with fixed cards at the left and right ends.
The cards form a vertical column, with fixed cards at the top and bottom.
A fixed first card sits at the left of a horizontal row of movable cards.

scenarios.name: mockup
scenarios.screen: Three labelled boxes sit on a canvas, and a smaller mockup beside it shows their target positions and sizes. Rulers accompany the canvas and mockup; the boxes start away from their targets and have corner resize handles, with no popup open.
never: A box already outside the canvas
An open image picker or layer panel
A numeric overlap score on the canvas

arrangements.text: The canvas is on the left and the half-size mockup is on the right, with rulers beside both.
The half-size mockup is on the left and the canvas is on the right, with rulers beside both.

scenarios.name: columns
scenarios.screen: A table shows four named columns, cell chips, and draggable dividers at the column edges. The columns start at widths that miss their targets; no picker or popup is open.
never: A numeric width readout attached to a divider

arrangements.text: The column names sit in a header row above their cell chips, with dividers between columns.
The column names sit in a header row above several rows of cell chips, with dividers running down from the header.
